reviewed: all 22 ABI functions (constants, getters, rely/deny, file, ERC20, mint, burn, DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, both permits)

findings.function: permit(v, r, s), permit(bytes), DOMAIN_SEPARATOR; def SafeMath
findings.decompiled: def mul(a, b): require b == uint8(b); return a * b ... mem[224] = SafeMath.mul(0x100...0, v); signer2 = ecrecover(_28, ...) # precompiled ... if owner == mem[_22 + 334 len 20]; mem[_22 + 386 len 4] = 371636862 ... static call owner with: args mem[_22 + 582 len 196]
findings.source: abi.encodePacked(r, s, v); if (signer == ecrecover(digest, v, r, s)) return true; signer.staticcall(abi.encodeCall(IERC1271.isValidSignature, (digest, signature)))
findings.issue: The uint8 range check of v is folded into an invented SafeMath.mul helper; the recovered signer is named signer2 but the comparison re-reads it from memory; the ERC1271 call keeps a decimal selector and raw argument memory because its buffer is built by a copy loop; 'x * bool(x)' is printed for x.
findings.rule: Never fold a parameter range check into an arithmetic helper; use the precompile's named result; decode a call whose argument buffer is a copy of a buffer with a known selector at its start; fold x * bool(x) to x.

findings.source: if (what == "name") name = data; else if (what == "symbol") symbol = data;
findings.issue: The shared string-copy code is printed once with the slot number as a variable, so the stores to name and symbol appear as stor[_3].
findings.rule: When a slot variable has a small set of constant values with named storage, print one copy per value (or comment the names) instead of raw stor[_3].

findings.issue: solc immutables read as 0, so the cached domain separator is 0 and the cache test becomes 'chainid == 0'.
findings.rule: Known artifact of immutables in runtime code; show them as named unknown constants rather than 0.

notes: No loops in SDAO.sol (source_loops 0); the two text whiles copy the ERC1271 call data (P7). ERC20 logic (unchecked balance updates, allowance max, invalid-address checks), mint's checked totalSupply, burn, file and both permit paths match the source.
summary: All 22 functions reviewed; no source loops and the semantics match. Only small readability problems: a parameter check folded into an invented SafeMath helper, the ecrecover result re-read from memory, the ERC1271 call left raw, and file()'s merged slot variable.
